svg.aria-label: Unit and integration: Jest with React Testing Library. Visual regression: Playwright screenshots every Storybook story and compares it with the baseline. Config playwright-storybook.config.ts, tests e2e/storybook-visual.spec.ts. End-to-end: Playwright (https://playwright.dev/) against the production build: navigation, theme/language toggle, contact form, service pages, project demos and 404 handling. Config playwright.config.ts, tests e2e/app.spec.ts. Storybook 8: Storybook (https://storybook.js.org/) is the component library and the visual documentation, on localhost:6006. Stories: Atoms: Button, CodeBlock, LanguageToggle. Molecules: BentoCard, SectionHeader. Organisms: Navigation, Footer. Addons: Autodocs, controls panel, dark/light toolbar toggle, responsive viewport presets, accessibility (a11y) audit panel
